kind: Synthetic SVG software fixtures, not camera photographs

files.name: identical-copy.svg
files.note: Exact copy; only the filename is different.

files.name: metadata-change.svg
files.note: One metadata byte changed. Drawing instructions unchanged.

files.name: visible-change.svg
files.note: One color byte changed; same byte count, different drawing.

files.name: truncated.svg
files.note: Only the first 200 bytes retained; deliberately incomplete XML.

cases.label: Identical copy
cases.lesson: A new filename did not change the contents. Opening the image is still a separate check.

cases.label: Metadata-only change
cases.lesson: The drawing commands are unchanged, but one metadata byte differs. A mismatch alone is not a corruption diagnosis.

cases.label: Same size, different drawing
cases.lesson: One color byte differs. Equal file sizes did not establish identical contents.

cases.label: Truncated file
cases.lesson: The comparison detects different contents, not the cause. This supplied fixture is deliberately incomplete.

cases.label: Two identical broken inputs
cases.lesson: Identical contents can still be invalid image data. A match is not an image-health check.
